---
title: "Container Development with spython"
format: html
execute:
  eval: false
---

This notebook develops a project container interactively using the Python Singularity interface, `spython`.

The workflow is:

1. Build a disposable writable sandbox for interactive exploration.
2. Use `spython` to execute commands inside the sandbox.
3. Translate successful commands into a reproducible Singularity definition file.
4. Build the final `.sif` artifact.
5. Validate the final image against the project.

The notebook session is disposable. The durable outputs are the Singularity definition file, final `.sif`, logs, and project-level configuration.

```{python}
#| eval: true
from pathlib import Path
from pyprojroot import here
import os
import subprocess

from spython.main import Client

from rich.console import Console
from rich.panel import Panel
from rich.columns import Columns

console = Console()

user = os.environ["USER"]

PROJECT_NAME = "prospectorDHSNepal"

PROJECT_DIR = Path(
    "/n/holylabs/cgolden_lab/Lab/frontier/works/prospectors/prospectorDHSNepal"
)

WORKBENCH_DIR = Path(
    "/n/holylabs/cgolden_lab/Lab/frontier/town/tinashe/rse-workbench"
)

RUNTIME_DIR = WORKBENCH_DIR / "projects" / PROJECT_NAME
CONTAINER_DIR = RUNTIME_DIR / "containers"
CACHE_DIR = RUNTIME_DIR / "cache" / user
LOG_DIR = RUNTIME_DIR / "logs"
SIF = CONTAINER_DIR / f"{PROJECT_NAME.lower()}-amd64.sif"
SANDBOX = Path(f"/tmp/{user}-{PROJECT_NAME}-sandbox")

DEF = PROJECT_DIR / ".devcontainer" / "Singularity.def"

for path in [CONTAINER_DIR, SANDBOX, CACHE_DIR, LOG_DIR, DEF.parent]:
    path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

os.environ["TMPDIR"] = "/tmp"
os.environ["SINGULARITY_TMPDIR"] = "/tmp"
os.environ["SINGULARITY_CACHEDIR"] = str(CACHE_DIR / "singularity")
Path(os.environ["SINGULARITY_CACHEDIR"]).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

console.print(
    Panel.fit(
        f"Project: {PROJECT_DIR}\n"
        f"Workbench: {WORKBENCH_DIR}\n"
        f"Runtime: {RUNTIME_DIR}\n"
        f"Sandbox: {SANDBOX}\n"
        f"SIF: {SIF}\n"
        f"Definition: {DEF}\n"
        f"Singularity cache: {os.environ['SINGULARITY_CACHEDIR']}",
        title="Container Development Runtime",
    )
)
```

## Helper functions

Below are some helper functions for running shell commands and 
executing commands inside the sandbox.

```{python}
#| eval: true
def show(result):
    stdout = Panel(
        result.stdout.rstrip() or "<empty>",
        title="stdout",
        border_style="green",
    )

    stderr = Panel(
        result.stderr.rstrip() or "<empty>",
        title="stderr",
        border_style="yellow",
    )

    console.print(
        Panel(
            Columns([stdout, stderr]),
            title=f"Exit code: {result.returncode}",
            subtitle=" ".join(map(str, result.args)),
            border_style="green" if result.returncode == 0 else "red",
        )
    )


def shell(cmd, check=False):
    result = subprocess.run(
        cmd,
        shell=True,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )

    if check and result.returncode != 0:
        show(result)
        raise RuntimeError(f"Command failed with exit code {result.returncode}")

    return result


def spython_exec(
    command,
    *,
    image=SANDBOX,
    writable=False,
    fakeroot=False,
    bind_project=False,
):
    options = ["--no-home"]

    if writable:
        options.append("--writable")

    if fakeroot:
        options.append("--fakeroot")

    if bind_project:
        options += ["--bind", f"{PROJECT_DIR}:/work"]

    return Client.execute(
        image=str(image),
        command=["bash", "--noprofile", "--norc", "-c", command],
        options=options,
        sudo=False,
    )
```

## 1. Build a disposable sandbox

This sandbox is for learning and exploration. It is not the final artifact.

```{python}
#| eval: false
base_image = "docker://spack/rockylinux8:develop"

Client.build(
    image=str(SANDBOX),
    recipe=base_image,
    options=[
        "--fakeroot",
        "--sandbox",
        "--fix-perms",
        "--force",
    ],
    sudo=False,
)
```

```{python}
#| eval: false
spython_exec("ls /", writable=True, fakeroot=True)
```

## 2. Explore commands interactively

Use the sandbox to discover what the container needs. First
establish that spack is available:

```{python}
#| eval: false
spython_exec(
    ". /opt/spack/share/spack/setup-env.sh && spack --version",
    writable=True,
    fakeroot=True,
)
```

Then use the rockylinux package manager to install system
dependencies.

```{python}
#| eval: false
spython_exec(
    "dnf install -y epel-release",
    writable=True,
    fakeroot=True,
)
```

```{python}
#| eval: false
spython_exec(
    "dnf install -y cmake make libcurl-devel openssl-devel git libX11-devel abseil-cpp-devel udunits2-devel libxml2-devel libicu-devel fontconfig-devel freetype-devel cairo-devel libpng-devel libtiff-devel sqlite-devel fribidi-devel harfbuzz-devel",
    writable=True,
    fakeroot=True,
)
```

At this point, we know that the low level system dependencies are installed. We will next create a work directory for the project.

```{python}
#| eval: false
spython_exec(
    "ls /work",
    writable=True,
    fakeroot=True,
    bind_project=True,
)
```

```{python}
#| eval: false
spython_exec(
    "mkdir -p /work",
    writable=True,
    fakeroot=True,
    bind_project=False,
)
```

```{python}
#| eval: false
spython_exec(
    "ls /work",
    writable=True,
    fakeroot=True,
    bind_project=True,
)
```

## 3. Convert successful exploration into a definition file

Once the exploratory commands work, write them into `Singularity.def`.

```{python}
#| eval: false
definition = """Bootstrap: docker
From: spack/rockylinux8:develop

%post
    dnf install -y epel-release
    dnf install -y cmake make libcurl-devel openssl-devel git libX11-devel abseil-cpp-devel udunits2-devel libxml2-devel libicu-devel fontconfig-devel freetype-devel cairo-devel libpng-devel libtiff-devel sqlite-devel fribidi-devel harfbuzz-devel

    mkdir -p /work

%environment
    export LC_ALL=C
    export LANG=C

%runscript
    exec "$@"
"""

DEF.write_text(definition)

console.print(f"Wrote {DEF}")
```

## 4. Build the final SIF

The final `.sif` is the durable container artifact.

```{python}
#| eval: false
Client.build(
    image=str(SIF),
    recipe=str(DEF),
    options=[
        "--fakeroot",
        "--force",
    ],
    sudo=False,
)
```

## 5. Validate the final SIF

The final image should run without `--writable`.

```{python}
#| eval: false
spython_exec(
    "pwd && ls / && . /opt/spack/share/spack/setup-env.sh && spack --version",
    image=SIF,
    writable=False,
    fakeroot=False,
)
```

See if binding the project directory into it works:

```{python}
#| eval: false
spython_exec(
    "cd /work && ls",
    image=SIF,
    writable=False,
    fakeroot=False,
    bind_project=True,
)
```

Great!

## 6. Validate project Spack environment

The container provides Spack. Let's ensure it's going to
install its stuff into the right place by querying the
config:

```{python}
#| eval: false
spython_exec(
    """
    . /opt/spack/share/spack/setup-env.sh &&
    ls / &&
    cd /work &&
    spack env activate -d . &&
    spack config blame config
    """,
    image=SIF,
    writable=False,
    bind_project=True,
)
```

It's writing to the internal container's /opt/software directory,
but we want it to write to the project directory. Let's set that up:

```{python}
#| eval: false
spython_exec(
    """
    . /opt/spack/share/spack/setup-env.sh &&
    cd /work &&
    spack env activate -d . &&
    spack config get config
    """,
    image=SIF,
    writable=False,
    bind_project=True,
)
```

## 7. Optional: submit long Spack install with submitit

Use this only after the final SIF is working.

```{python}
#| eval: false
import submitit

SUBMITIT_DIR = RUNTIME_DIR / "submitit"
SUBMITIT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

n_cpus = 8

executor = submitit.AutoExecutor(folder=str(SUBMITIT_DIR / "%j"))

executor.update_parameters(
    timeout_min=360,
    slurm_partition="hsph",
    mem_gb=32.0,
    cpus_per_task=n_cpus,
)
```

```{python}
#| eval: false
def install_spack_stack(n_cpus=8):
    from pathlib import Path
    from spython.main import Client

    project_dir = Path(
        "/n/holylabs/cgolden_lab/Lab/frontier/works/prospectors/prospectorDHSNepal"
    )

    sif = Path(
        "/n/holylabs/cgolden_lab/Lab/frontier/works/rse-workbench/projects/prospectorDHSNepal/containers/prospectordhsnepal-amd64.sif"
    )

    command = f"""
    . /opt/spack/share/spack/setup-env.sh &&
    cd /work &&
    spack env activate -d . &&
    spack install --fail-fast -j{n_cpus}
    """

    return Client.execute(
        image=str(sif),
        command=["bash", "--noprofile", "--norc", "-c", command],
        options=[
            "--no-home",
            "--bind",
            f"{project_dir}:/work",
        ],
        sudo=False,
    )
```

```{python}
#| eval: false
job = executor.submit(install_spack_stack, n_cpus)
job.job_id
```

Record the job ID here:

```text
Spack install job ID:
```

```{python}
#| eval: false
job.done()
```

```{python}
#| eval: false
job.result()
```

## 8. Copying this notebook into a project

When the procedure is stable:

1. Copy this notebook into the project.
2. Edit only the first configuration chunk.
3. Run the build and validation chunks once.
4. Commit the notebook and `Singularity.def`.
5. Do not commit `.sif`, caches, logs, submitit folders, or sandboxes.

Suggested `.gitignore` additions:

```gitignore
*.sif
*.img
*.sqsh
sandbox/
sandboxes/
submitit/
logs/
cache/
```
